list: the official 55 trophies, as published by PlayStation and listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles
note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as PlayStation publishes it. Every guide below is written in our own words for this guide; each one names the sources its facts come from, and no guide text is copied from any source.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum lands the moment the other 54 trophies are yours, so there is no separate task here: work the list in roadmap order and this pops last. All 55 trophies are offline and single-player, so nothing depends on another player or a server.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The big one: reach 100% completion. The checklist unlocks after the story under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion, but progress made during the story already counts toward it. It is far more forgiving than it sounds — closer to 60% true completion. Most side quests are not needed at all, many collectible types are not required, and others are only partly required: scan any 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles, study any 100 of the 255 animals, and complete any 70 of the 80 challenges. The only things that need everything are the robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. Nothing on the checklist is missable, and it can all be done in free-roam after the story.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
GTASpotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements: the full official list

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game (300 are needed for 100% completion). Four kinds count toward the total: 130 stunt jumps over ramps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps. Mix them freely and pick what is quickest for you — the under-the-bridge runs are the fastest. Track progress in Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, or on the map under Exploration, then Stunt Spots, where every stunt keeps its own name and marker.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race or race challenge, and performing a stunt. Check Progress, then Activities, to see which types you have done. The story introduces most of them, and the rest appear as blue icons when you unfog the map, so this usually pops on its own while you chase the other trophies.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. The golds are not very hard, and every range counts toward 100% completion as well, so work through them alongside the checklist rather than leaving them all to the end.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. There are 42 drone races in total, and all 42 are needed for 100% completion, but for this trophy one win per location is enough.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 on offer. Winning the same race twice does not count — each win has to be a race you have not won before, so spread your wins around the map.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui introduces Cal, he sends a text that marks a fishing spot with a purple icon on the map, west of Key Lento. Take the quest and out-fish him.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. There are four video games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1, and Bang For Your Buck sits in arcade machines around the world. Finishing all the levels of any one of them once is enough — you do not need to beat every challenge in it.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's questline, which is Lucia-only. It opens in Chapter 3, when Andy calls Lucia and texts her an address in Belville. Five quests lead to the trophy: Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1 to 3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. All of it stays available after the story, so nothing here is missable.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's questline. It opens in Chapter 1 after the mission Island Dreams: Kenton calls, then marks himself with a green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at 7 shipwrecks — find the chests on the ocean floor with the metal detector and bring them back to him. He goes quiet for a stretch in Chapters 1 and 2 but returns later, so nothing here is missable. Track it under Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's questline. It opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, marked at the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County. Five quests lead to the trophy: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. All of it stays available after the story.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands. Only some strangers count toward this one: Kirk (the Skunk Ape hunts), Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed, while Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count here — their questlines have their own trophies. Every stranger strand stays available in free-roam after the story, and the trophy tracker in the trophy list shows how many you have done.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
GTA Zone — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's questline, Randy's Wish List. It opens in Chapter 3 during the mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, when you steal the Zorrusso for Randy and unlock the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage in west Vice City. Scan cars with the WAiNK app to check them against the list, and deliver them in good condition for better pay. Track it under Map, then Robberies, then Randy's Wish List. It can all be done after the story.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's questline, which is Jason-only. It opens in Chapter 3 after the mission Here, Kitty Kitty: purple markers point to synthetic labs in Vice City, which you destroy in Take Out Kitty Litter. After enough labs are gone, Tyrone hands you Spin On This to shut the labs down for good. Everything stays available after the story.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida: 18 spots in 10 locations, tracked under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. Each spot counts twice if both Jason and Lucia meditate there, and for 100% completion only 15 of the 18 are needed. POSSIBLY MISSABLE — the one trophy in the game that can be missed. One meditation happens at Jason's house in Chapter 1 and is gone after that chapter: after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her out to the balcony when she says she is going to meditate, and choose Accept. It raises the counter by 1 but is not marked as a spot, and it is still unconfirmed whether it is required for the trophy — do it while you can. The last spot cannot be done until both characters can play together, unlocked after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
GTASpotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements: the full official list

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret Vogel. His questline opens after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, when Jason gets a text marking Veteran Hunted in Lummox County — it is Jason-only. Bret hands you the Killtelligence SM-69 hunting rifle and marks hunting spots on the map; bring him the animals he asks for. A clean single shot leaves the animal in pristine condition and pays more, but it is not required. All 15 of his Target Decks are needed for 100% completion, so this pops naturally on the way.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 card sets hidden across Leonida, and any 3 complete sets will do — you do not need to find every card in the game.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Hold up on the D-pad and then R1 to scan landmarks, curiosities and sculptures in the world — 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures are listed, and there are more than 100 scannable spots in total, so any 100 count.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges. There are 10 more than you need for the trophy, and 70 are needed for 100% completion, so pick the easiest ones and skip the hardest. Track them under Progress, then Challenges. Most of them pop naturally while you chase the other trophies, so leave this for one of your last trophies and mop up the quickest ones left.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
GTASpotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements: the full official list

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then escape the heat. This is available once you can free-roam together after Coffee Break in Chapter 2: call your partner by holding right on the D-pad and pressing Triangle, cause chaos until you hit 4 stars, then break out of the red heat zone — a fast sports bike helps, and the train tunnel north of Ambrosia is a handy escape route, since the helicopter cannot see you in there. It also tends to pop on its own while robbing the big bank vaults in Chapter 4, which always bring 4 stars.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Keep the red and blue flashing wanted level alive — not the red heat level — across all three robberies. Wear body armor, carry sticky bombs and healing items, and loot a couple of items plus the safe in each shop. The three jewelry stores in north Vice City work well, once Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 unlock them. The pop is delayed by about half a minute after the third shop, and if it does not fire, hit a fourth shop and keep going.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Open the WAiNK app on your phone — hold up on the D-pad to use it instantly — and scan cars, bikes, boats and aircraft as they pass. Scanning is enough; you never have to drive them. A busy road does the job fast, and since 100% completion needs 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles scanned, this pops on the way. Check your totals under Touchpad, then Progress, then Vehicles.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger it with L3 and R3 while aiming a firearm: it slows time, highlights weak spots and drains the purple focus bar, which only lasts a few seconds. Buff focus first with food, drinks, a wash or Adrenaline, then line up five enemies — gang operations are good hunting grounds — and drop them fast with an accurate automatic rifle. It does not seem to count against soldiers, police or civilians. Focus levels up through shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so it gets easier late in the game.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport. Steal one of the big passenger planes docked at a departure terminal — one hooked to a boarding bridge, not a plane parked out on the field; the plane at terminals E3 and E4 is the easiest. Get upstairs into the cockpit, reverse onto the strip, take off and fly at least 1 km away from the airport. You can walk in through the terminal, but driving through a fence onto the airfield is faster.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. They stand in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Drive in through the gate — or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance — climb into a Rhino and shoot enemies until the trophy pops.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3: that unlocks the Snap Gun and marks jewelry robberies on the map. Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun instead of kicking it in, find the safe code note in the back room, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm. The trophy pops shortly after you leave. Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City is a good spot.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Start with the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner along to carry a second bag. After that, buy van tips from Yasmani for $10,000 a time. Any 5 of the 8 vaults count for the trophy, but all 8 are needed for 100% completion. Every vault robbery brings a 4-star wanted level, so keep a fast bike ready and switch vehicles to shake the heat.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It pops automatically in the same Chapter 4 mission that opens bank vault robberies — robbing the vault counts as robbing the truck. Or do it earlier: block an armored truck near a bank in Vice City, stick a bomb on its back door, blow it open and escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop once you have done his quests.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida: fully unfog the map. The fastest way is by plane — fly over every blacked-out area until the whole map is visible.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 operations in total, and all 39 are needed for 100% completion, but one per gang is enough for this trophy. They show as yellow icons on the map when you get near them, and you can track each gang's count under Progress, then Gangs.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, buy an Apple Martini and drink it while standing next to the bar.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. You need the blue Banshee in the showroom in south Vice City — and the Key Cloner from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS to steal it. Hack in, then drive straight forward through the showroom window. It only pops for this exact car, a nod to the Banshee from GTA III.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt and Associates bowling alley. Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway, which you blow open with sticky bombs. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item. You first go there in the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, but the valuables can be collected on a later visit too, so it is not missable.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal: get both Jason and Lucia to maximum strength at the same time. Check strength under Touchpad, then Jason and Lucia. Work out together — call your partner along by holding right on the D-pad and pressing Triangle, and while one trains, the other progresses too. Gyms are marked under Map, then Activities; you can also work out at home after the story.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make 500 choices that move your criminal profile. Turn on profile notifications under Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, then Criminal Profile, and watch for the demon-face icon: stealthy jobs, clean escapes, knocking enemies out without killing them, or going on a rampage all count. It builds passively through every robbery and fight, so leave it until last — if anything is left over, it farms quickly.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. This one is still unconfirmed: PowerPyx believes it is tied to the Payday Loans store from the prologue, possibly robbing it again later in a specific way, in Little Cuba, Vice City. Treat this as unconfirmed and check the cited guide for the latest word before hunting for it.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Complete the UFO easter egg. After 2AM, alone, drive the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County: sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside. If it is there, follow the path into the woods to the UFO's blue light in the sky, approach it, and it drops an abducted woman — talk to her, offer to help, and walk back to her car at the roadside. The spawn is slightly random, so drive away and come back if the car is not there.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Ride any bike and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds. Crowded spots like Vice City or Ocean Beach are the place to try it.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check to meet Raul's crew and unlock the Dye Pack Jammer. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and carry the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays best. The total counts across all robberies, so you do not need to bring $250,000 at once. Bank vaults alone can pay up to $205,000 in a single job.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the priciest, so they get you there fastest. Every shop type counts: Ammu-Nation, mod shops, clothing, footwear, salons, tattoo studios and electronics.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties: the 8 purchasable garages, for $160,000 in total. The 4 story garages do not count. Garages go on sale after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, when the Vice City Real Estate app lands on your phone — buy them through the app. Robberies fund the spree, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3 and 4.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app arrives after the Chapter 2 mission Moses; it lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to your location anywhere. Each garage adds parking spots, so buy garages first (see Little Boxes). Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray, then Register — early on he only takes cars without trackers, and from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Cheap cars and bikes keep the cost down.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)
